metadata.title: Data Density Pass 21 -- Day 1 Opening Action Coverage Gap Fill (Ticks 4-12)
metadata.description: The very opening moments of the battle at ticks 4-12 are currently thin. This pass adds Buford's picket dispositions along the ridges west of Gettysburg, Pettigrew's approach on the Chambersburg Pike, Heth's division in column, and the first artillery contact. The birth of the battle.

placements.notes: Marcellus Jones's company has fired -- now the full 8th IL regiment deploys as the Confederate column approaches
3rd Indiana screening south of the pike
Archer's brigade -- lead brigade of Heth's division. Headed for Gettysburg for shoes.
Davis's brigade -- following Archer on Chambersburg Pike
Pegram's battalion following Heth's infantry -- 5 batteries about to deploy on Herr Ridge
8th Illinois falling back slowly toward McPherson's Ridge as Confederate pressure builds
Archer deploying into line of battle -- Heth orders the advance despite Hill's warnings
Davis deploying north of the pike
Calef's Battery A deployed on Herr Ridge -- the first Union artillery in position
Pegram's 5 batteries deploying on Herr Ridge -- facing Calef across the valley
Gamble's brigade dismounted in a thin line on McPherson's Ridge -- buying time for Reynolds
Devin's brigade screening all the northern roads -- Barlow will arrive on one of these
Archer crossing Willoughby Run -- he is in the valley where Herbst Woods awaits
Davis advancing north of the pike toward the Railroad Cut
8th Illinois now at McPherson's Ridge -- holding every foot they can
Calef firing -- 6 guns vs Pegram's 20. Buying time.
Iron Brigade double-quicking toward McPherson's Ridge -- Reynolds has told them to come fast
Cutler's brigade rushing forward on the Chambersburg Pike
Robinson's division following -- the I Corps is all coming at the double-quick
